set.name: Concept of a Function

set.reason: The formula-based evaluation criterion substitutes the independent-variable value into an algebraic expression.
The function value is the output assigned to a particular input, using the unique-correspondence definition.
set.scope: meaning of function value and its inverse lookup

set.reason: Vertex interpretation uses the geometric meaning of the shifted-square form.
set.scope: reading vertex, axis and monotonicity after conversion

set.reason: The explicit criterion is rewriting ax^2+bx+c identically as a(x-h)^2+k, which is exactly the expression rewrite. This edge fits that criterion better than the equation-solving method node does.
set.scope: criterion: complete the square into vertex form

set.reason: Knowing that the vertex is (h,k) supports reading the maximum or minimum from vertex form. The extremum can also be argued algebraically, which keeps this short of a strict requirement.
The source starts from vertex form; general-form completion is avoidable for interval extrema.
Choosing the added term (b/2a)^2 and checking the identity by expansion both rely on the perfect square identity, including its middle term. Every route to this rewrite uses it.

criteria: 能处理限定区间的最值
set.description: 利用顶点求二次函数的最大值或最小值，注意自变量取值范围。
set.name: Maximum and Minimum Values of Quadratic Functions

criteria: 能由函数值反求自变量
set.description: 给定自变量的值，代入函数关系求对应的函数值。
set.name: Function Values

criteria: 能说出顶点、对称轴和增减性
set.description: 通过配方化为顶点式，得出顶点坐标 (-b/2a, (4ac-b²)/4a)，并研究增减性。
set.name: Graphs and Properties of y=ax²+bx+c

criteria: Factor the nonzero leading coefficient and add and subtract the matching square term.
Check the resulting identity by expansion and preserve the original expression for all allowed variable values.
set.description: For a real a!=0, rewrite a*x^2+b*x+c identically as a*(x+b/(2*a))^2+c-b^2/(4*a) by adding and subtracting the matching square term. This node covers the algebraic rewrite itself; solving an equation, interpreting a function graph, finding a circle center, and proving a bound are separate uses.
set.name: Completing the square in an expression

set.description: (a±b)²=a²±2ab+b²，可用图形面积解释。
set.name: Perfect Square Formula

set.description: 不等式两边同加（减）同一个数，不等号方向不变；同乘（除以）正数方向不变，同乘（除以）负数方向改变。
set.name: Properties of Inequalities

set.description: 抛物线 y=a(x-h)²+k 的顶点为 (h,k)，对称轴为 x=h，可由 y=ax² 平移得到。
set.name: The Graph and Translation of \(y=a(x-h)^2+k\)

criteria: 能处理负数和分数的代入
set.description: 把字母的取值代入代数式并按运算顺序计算，注意负数代入要加括号。
set.name: Evaluating algebraic expressions
